class.name: BehaviorTreeInverter
class.brief_description: Inverts a child task's success and failure.
class.description: Returns [constant BehaviorTreeTask.FAILURE] when its child succeeds, and vice versa. The [constant BehaviorTreeTask.RUNNING] status is passed through unchanged. Null child resources fail.

method.name: set_task
method.description: Sets the wrapped task, rejecting cycles.
